confirm_back_reason: The agent explicitly summarized the quantity, price per kilo, pickup deadline, and cash payment terms, and the buyer clearly agreed to all terms before concluding the call.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Assalam-o-Alaikum Bhai! Main Fresh Mart Clifton se AI assistant bol raha hoon. Do minute milenge? Kaam ki baat hai.

transcript.speaker: buyer
transcript.text: Walaikum Assalam bhai, haan bolo khairiat? Konsa maal hai aur kis hisab se de rahe ho?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Bhai hamare paas 50 kilo Sindhri Mangoes hain, ripe hain aur skin pe thore spots hain magar andar se bilkul meethay aur juicy hain, juice ke liye best hain. Rate sirf Rs 180 per kilo hai, kya kehte hain, chahiye aapko?

transcript.speaker: buyer
transcript.text: Bhai maal thora spotted hai, thora sa gunjaish nikalo na, 165 ya 170 tak lagao toh saara 50 kilo utha leta hoon cash pe.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Chalein Bhai, Rs 170 per kilo pe deal karte hain. 50 kilo Sindhri Mangoes, Rs 170 per kilo, cash on pickup payment, aur maal aapko aaj 3 PM tak uthana hoga—kya aapko yeh sab manzoor hai?

transcript.speaker: buyer
transcript.text: Chalo zabardast bhai, 170 theek hai, mujhe bilkul manzoor hai. Main 2 baje tak banda bhej kar cash deke maal uthwa leta hoon.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Chalein phir, sauda pakka! 2 baje bhej dein, maal ready hoga. Bohat shukriya Bhai, Allah Hafiz!
